ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْ هُوَ لِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ جَامِعٌ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī huwa li kulli khayrin jāmi`.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family in whom every good is gathered!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ وَ أَزِلْ عَنْ قُلُوْبِنَا الْبَرَاقِعَ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa azil `an qulūbinā ‘l-barāqi`.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and remove the veils from our hearts!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْنَ كَانَ مَجْمَعُهُمْ خَيْرَ الْمَجَامِعِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī,  Alladhīna kana majma`uhum khayra ‘l-majāmi`.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family those whose congregation is the best of congregations!
